title: Kalshi and Polymarket bets on clinical trials criticized as 'ghastly'
excerpt: As a soon-to-be seventh grader, Joshua Pederson's son is not exactly brimming with enthusiasm when he talks about the upcoming school year.
content_html:
As a soon-to-be seventh grader, Joshua Pederson's son is not exactly brimming with enthusiasm when he talks about the upcoming school year.

"The thing I'm looking forward to most in seventh grade is lunch, and the thing I'm looking forward to least is everything else," said the 12-year-old.

Related Story: NPR

Art is his passion, but he doesn't take classes. He likes teaching himself.

"I like drawing scary stuff and robots," he said. "Because I think scary stuff and robots are cool."

Two years ago, his parents, who live in Boston, noticed a lump around his ribs that quickly spiraled into a nightmare scenario: It was cancer.

Pederson asked that his son's name be withheld to discuss details of his medical condition.

After months of grueling chemotherapy and radiation, he was declared cancer-free last summer. Months later, however, the cancer returned. So Pederson entered his son into a clinical trial for a novel treatment.

That's around the time Pederson read the news that prediction market sites Kalshi and Polymarket have begun allowing people to bet on the outcomes of clinical trials and whether the Food and Drug Administration will approve new medications.

"What seemed to be missed in the CEO statements was the fact that there were going to be patients on the other side of these bets," said Pederson, who is a humanities professor at Boston University.

Bettors will make or lose money based on the success or failure of a clinical trial, a situation Pederson views as horrific.

"A clinical trial failing is a more sanitized euphemism for, people are going to suffer, people are going to die, people are going to have one fewer clinical option available to them in one of the most difficult medical situations of their entire life," he said.

Researchers fear 'undermining trial integrity'

Related Story: NPR

Billions of dollars are traded every week on the lightly regulated prediction market sites, where users bet on everything from movie reviews to elections to conflicts in the Middle East. Clinical trials are just the latest area where the industry's rapid growth is raising ethical questions.

Kalshi claims such bets will provide a new source of information about which drugs will get approved, and what clinical trials will show promising results, which the company says can help investors decide what new drugs to fund.

Related Story: NPR

"If you want to ban profiting from the failure of clinical trials, you would start with the stock market, where the financial incentive for this type of profit is orders of magnitude larger," said Kalshi spokesman Jack Such, pointing to stock market short sellers who have profited from clinical trial failures.

"While Kalshi and the stock market are the same in this regard, they do differ in one important way: the stock market doesn't give any valuable information to researchers," Such said.

Drug trial researchers, though, are far from convinced.

David Tsai, who runs clinical trials at a biotech company in the San Francisco Bay Area, started an online petition pushing for such betting to be banned, making the case that betting on drug trials "threatens the very foundation of trust and integrity in biotechnology."

Tsai is concerned that the prospect of betting provides those involved with a clinical trial a reason to tamper with the results for a prediction market payout.

"If we were running a trial for an oncology drug that requires an infusion, a pharmacist who had placed a bet saying that it's gonna work well, or doesn't work well, could obviously adjust the infusion rate, could adjust the source temperature of the drug," he said. "They could change any number of variables that could obviously have a direct impact [on] how the trial and the data and the patient safety would come out."

Another skeptic is Nicholas Zaorsky, a professor of radiation oncology at the Mayo Clinic in Jacksonville, Fla., who has helped run clinical trials and agrees that prediction markets can interfere with the advancement of life-saving drugs.

"Prediction markets can be valuable in some settings because they aggregate information, but clinical trials are fundamentally different: investigators, coordinators, and sometimes even participants can directly influence aspects of the outcomes being wagered on," Zaorsky said. "That creates financial incentives that risk undermining trial integrity."

Patient's father: People betting on trials are 'distanced from the real cost'

Kalshi has tapped its own experts, including Anne Wojcicki, the founder of genetic testing company 23andMe, to vouch for the markets as a way of staying ahead of medical breakthroughs and for making clinical trials more accessible.

"Most patients don't know about the choices available in clinical trials or which programs are most promising. The opportunity to have an open, transparent dataset about trial probabilities is extremely promising and empowering for people," a white paper sponsored by Kalshi stated.

On Kalshi, users can currently bet on whether a weight-loss medication and a breast cancer treatment will be approved by federal regulators and on what date.

Polymarket, which declined to comment, is taking wagers on the approval of cancer treatments and whether the U.S. will allow Chinese peptides to be sold to Americans.

The possibility of insider trading, Kalshi argues, will be minimized by company safeguards verifying employment and tools to surveil for unusual market activity.

Related Story: NPR

Indeed, prediction markets have helped identify insider traders in other markets, from President Trump's teleprompter operator to former Congressman George Santos to a special forces soldier who was betting based on military intelligence about the toppling of Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro.

Related Story: NPR

Given just how many people can be involved with clinical trials, Tsai thinks it might not be so easy to preemptively catch every bad actor.

Pederson is also skeptical. He argues the markets obscure the patients at the center of clinical trials, who have the most at stake from their outcomes.

"One of the things that has struck me about these platforms is that they're flashy and they're gamified in such a way that you're often kind of distanced from the real cost," he said.

Kalshi says it is offering bets on late-stage clinical trials where participants have already been chosen. And it says it won't allow betting on markets where all trial subjects are minors. But that could change.

If it does, Pederson says wondering whether researchers in a trial could be motivated by prediction market profits will add to his anxieties — and to the burden his son is already carrying.

"The weight on him and what he's being asked to do, and what he's being asked to endure, is already so much," Pederson said.

He hopes that Kalshi and Polymarket will stop letting speculators place bets that clinical trials won't succeed.

Bettors, he argues, should not be rooting for an experimental medicine to fail just to earn a buck.

"It's a dark idea," he said. "It's quite ghastly."

sentences.zh: 在旧金山湾区一家生物技术公司负责临床试验的大卫·蔡（David Tsai）发起了一份在线请愿书，要求禁止此类投注，他认为药物试验投注“威胁到了生物技术领域信任和诚信的基础”。

blocks.html_en: Tsai is concerned that the prospect of betting provides those involved with a clinical trial a reason to tamper with the results for a prediction market payout.

sentences.en: Tsai is concerned that the prospect of betting provides those involved with a clinical trial a reason to tamper with the results for a prediction market payout.
sentences.zh: 蔡担心，赌博的前景为那些参与临床试验的人提供了篡改预测市场支付结果的理由。

blocks.html_en: "If we were running a trial for an oncology drug that requires an infusion, a pharmacist who had placed a bet saying that it's gonna work well, or doesn't work well, could obviously adjust the infusion rate, could adjust the source temperature of the drug," he said. "They could change any number of variables that could obviously have a direct impact [on] how the trial and the data and the patient safety would come out."

sentences.en: "If we were running a trial for an oncology drug that requires an infusion, a pharmacist who had placed a bet saying that it's gonna work well, or doesn't work well, could obviously adjust the infusion rate, could adjust the source temperature of the drug," he said.
sentences.zh: “如果我们正在对一种需要输注的肿瘤药物进行试验，药剂师打赌说它会很好地发挥作用，或者不会很好地发挥作用，显然可以调整输注速度，可以调整药物的源温度，”他说。

sentences.en: "They could change any number of variables that could obviously have a direct impact [on] how the trial and the data and the patient safety would come out."
sentences.zh: “他们可以改变任意数量的变量，这些变量显然可能对试验、数据和患者安全的结果产生直接影响。”

blocks.html_en: Another skeptic is Nicholas Zaorsky, a professor of radiation oncology at the Mayo Clinic in Jacksonville, Fla., who has helped run clinical trials and agrees that prediction markets can interfere with the advancement of life-saving drugs.

sentences.en: Another skeptic is Nicholas Zaorsky, a professor of radiation oncology at the Mayo Clinic in Jacksonville, Fla., who has helped run clinical trials and agrees that prediction markets can interfere with the advancement of life-saving drugs.
sentences.zh: 另一位怀疑论者是佛罗里达州杰克逊维尔梅奥诊所的放射肿瘤学教授尼古拉斯·扎尔斯基(Nicholas Zaorsky)，他帮助开展了临床试验，并同意预测市场可能会干扰救生药物的进步。

blocks.html_en: "Prediction markets can be valuable in some settings because they aggregate information, but clinical trials are fundamentally different: investigators, coordinators, and sometimes even participants can directly influence aspects of the outcomes being wagered on," Zaorsky said. "That creates financial incentives that risk undermining trial integrity."

sentences.en: "Prediction markets can be valuable in some settings because they aggregate information, but clinical trials are fundamentally different: investigators, coordinators, and sometimes even participants can directly influence aspects of the outcomes being wagered on," Zaorsky said.
sentences.zh: “预测市场在某些情况下可能很有价值，因为它们汇总信息，但临床试验有根本的不同：​​研究人员、协调员，有时甚至参与者都可以直接影响所押注结果的各个方面，”扎奥尔斯基说。

sentences.en: "That creates financial incentives that risk undermining trial integrity."
sentences.zh: “这会产生经济激励，从而有可能破坏试验的完整性。”

blocks.html_en: Patient's father: People betting on trials are 'distanced from the real cost'

sentences.en: Patient's father: People betting on trials are 'distanced from the real cost'
sentences.zh: 患者父亲：押注于试验的人“与真实成本相去甚远”

blocks.html_en: Kalshi has tapped its own experts, including Anne Wojcicki, the founder of genetic testing company 23andMe, to vouch for the markets as a way of staying ahead of medical breakthroughs and for making clinical trials more accessible.

sentences.en: Kalshi has tapped its own experts, including Anne Wojcicki, the founder of genetic testing company 23andMe, to vouch for the markets as a way of staying ahead of medical breakthroughs and for making clinical trials more accessible.
sentences.zh: Kalshi 聘请了自己的专家，包括基因检测公司 23andMe 的创始人 Anne Wojcicki，为市场提供担保，以此作为保持领先于医学突破并使临床试验更容易进行的一种方式。

blocks.html_en: "Most patients don't know about the choices available in clinical trials or which programs are most promising. The opportunity to have an open, transparent dataset about trial probabilities is extremely promising and empowering for people," a white paper sponsored by Kalshi stated.

sentences.en: "Most patients don't know about the choices available in clinical trials or which programs are most promising.
sentences.zh: “大多数患者不知道临床试验中可用的选择或哪些项目最有希望。

sentences.en: The opportunity to have an open, transparent dataset about trial probabilities is extremely promising and empowering for people," a white paper sponsored by Kalshi stated.
sentences.zh: 拥有一个关于试验概率的开放、透明的数据集的机会对人们来说是非常有希望和赋权的，”卡尔希赞助的一份白皮书指出。

blocks.html_en: On Kalshi, users can currently bet on whether a weight-loss medication and a breast cancer treatment will be approved by federal regulators and on what date.

sentences.en: On Kalshi, users can currently bet on whether a weight-loss medication and a breast cancer treatment will be approved by federal regulators and on what date.
sentences.zh: 在 Kalshi 上，用户目前可以押注减肥药物和乳腺癌治疗是否会获得联邦监管机构的批准以及批准日期。

blocks.html_en: Polymarket, which declined to comment, is taking wagers on the approval of cancer treatments and whether the U.S. will allow Chinese peptides to be sold to Americans.

sentences.en: Polymarket, which declined to comment, is taking wagers on the approval of cancer treatments and whether the U.S. will allow Chinese peptides to be sold to Americans.
sentences.zh: Polymarket 拒绝发表评论，该公司正在对癌症治疗的批准以及美国是否允许中国肽出售给美国人进行押注。

blocks.html_en: The possibility of insider trading, Kalshi argues, will be minimized by company safeguards verifying employment and tools to surveil for unusual market activity.

sentences.en: The possibility of insider trading, Kalshi argues, will be minimized by company safeguards verifying employment and tools to surveil for unusual market activity.
sentences.zh: 卡尔希认为，通过公司核实就业的保障措施和监控异常市场活动的工具，可以最大限度地减少内幕交易的可能性。

blocks.html_en: Related Story: NPR

sentences.en: Related Story: NPR
sentences.zh: 相关报道：NPR

blocks.html_en: Indeed, prediction markets have helped identify insider traders in other markets, from President Trump's teleprompter operator to former Congressman George Santos to a special forces soldier who was betting based on military intelligence about the toppling of Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro.

sentences.en: Indeed, prediction markets have helped identify insider traders in other markets, from President Trump's teleprompter operator to former Congressman George Santos to a special forces soldier who was betting based on military intelligence about the toppling of Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro.
sentences.zh: 事实上，预测市场已经帮助识别了其他市场的内幕交易者，从特朗普总统的提词器操作员到前国会议员乔治·桑托斯，再到根据军事情报对委内瑞拉领导人尼古拉斯·马杜罗倒台进行投注的特种部队士兵。

blocks.html_en: Related Story: NPR

sentences.en: Related Story: NPR
sentences.zh: 相关报道：NPR

blocks.html_en: Given just how many people can be involved with clinical trials, Tsai thinks it might not be so easy to preemptively catch every bad actor.

sentences.en: Given just how many people can be involved with clinical trials, Tsai thinks it might not be so easy to preemptively catch every bad actor.
sentences.zh: 考虑到有多少人可以参与临床试验，蔡认为要先发制人地抓住每一个坏人可能并不那么容易。

blocks.html_en: Pederson is also skeptical. He argues the markets obscure the patients at the center of clinical trials, who have the most at stake from their outcomes.

sentences.en: Pederson is also skeptical.
sentences.zh: 佩德森也对此表示怀疑。

sentences.en: He argues the markets obscure the patients at the center of clinical trials, who have the most at stake from their outcomes.
sentences.zh: 他认为，市场掩盖了处于临床试验中心的患者，他们对试验结果的利益最大。

blocks.html_en: "One of the things that has struck me about these platforms is that they're flashy and they're gamified in such a way that you're often kind of distanced from the real cost," he said.

sentences.en: "One of the things that has struck me about these platforms is that they're flashy and they're gamified in such a way that you're often kind of distanced from the real cost," he said.
sentences.zh: 他说：“这些平台让我印象深刻的一点是，它们很华丽，而且以一种游戏化的方式让你常常远离真正的成本。”

blocks.html_en: Kalshi says it is offering bets on late-stage clinical trials where participants have already been chosen. And it says it won't allow betting on markets where all trial subjects are minors. But that could change.

sentences.en: Kalshi says it is offering bets on late-stage clinical trials where participants have already been chosen.
sentences.zh: Kalshi 表示，它正在对已经选定参与者的后期临床试验进行押注。

sentences.en: And it says it won't allow betting on markets where all trial subjects are minors.
sentences.zh: 它还表示，不允许在所有试验对象都是未成年人的市场上进行投注。

sentences.en: But that could change.
sentences.zh: 但这可能会改变。

blocks.html_en: If it does, Pederson says wondering whether researchers in a trial could be motivated by prediction market profits will add to his anxieties — and to the burden his son is already carrying.

sentences.en: If it does, Pederson says wondering whether researchers in a trial could be motivated by prediction market profits will add to his anxieties — and to the burden his son is already carrying.
sentences.zh: 佩德森说，如果确实如此，他想知道试验中的研究人员是否会受到预测市场利润的激励，这会加剧他的焦虑，也会加重他儿子已经承受的负担。

blocks.html_en: "The weight on him and what he's being asked to do, and what he's being asked to endure, is already so much," Pederson said.

sentences.en: "The weight on him and what he's being asked to do, and what he's being asked to endure, is already so much," Pederson said.
sentences.zh: 佩德森说：“他承受的压力、他被要求做的事情以及他被要求忍受的事情已经太多了。”

blocks.html_en: He hopes that Kalshi and Polymarket will stop letting speculators place bets that clinical trials won't succeed.

sentences.en: He hopes that Kalshi and Polymarket will stop letting speculators place bets that clinical trials won't succeed.
sentences.zh: 他希望 Kalshi 和 Polymarket 停止让投机者押注临床试验不会成功。

blocks.html_en: Bettors, he argues, should not be rooting for an experimental medicine to fail just to earn a buck.

sentences.en: Bettors, he argues, should not be rooting for an experimental medicine to fail just to earn a buck.
sentences.zh: 他认为，投注者不应该仅仅为了赚钱而支持一种失败的实验药物。

blocks.html_en: "It's a dark idea," he said. "It's quite ghastly."

sentences.en: "It's a dark idea," he said.
sentences.zh: “这是一个黑暗的想法，”他说。

sentences.en: "It's quite ghastly."
sentences.zh: “这太可怕了。”

sentences.zh: 张艾莎，主持人：

blocks.html_en: Prediction market sites like Kalshi and Polymarket have turned the world into a casino. The companies allow bets on movie reviews, the president's words, conflicts in the Middle East, elections and so much more. But now they are introducing betting on clinical trials where the lives of patients are on the line. As NPR's Bobby Allyn reports, it's put the industry on the defensive amid growing pushback from researchers and patients.

sentences.en: Prediction market sites like Kalshi and Polymarket have turned the world into a casino.
sentences.zh: Kalshi 和 Polymarket 等预测市场网站已将世界变成了赌场。

sentences.en: The companies allow bets on movie reviews, the president's words, conflicts in the Middle East, elections and so much more.
sentences.zh: 这些公司允许对电影评论、总统言论、中东冲突、选举等进行投注。

sentences.en: But now they are introducing betting on clinical trials where the lives of patients are on the line.
sentences.zh: 但现在他们开始对危及患者生命的临床试验进行投注。

sentences.en: As NPR's Bobby Allyn reports, it's put the industry on the defensive amid growing pushback from researchers and patients.
sentences.zh: 正如美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的鲍比·艾林 (Bobby Allyn) 报道的那样，由于研究人员和患者的抵制越来越强烈，该行业已处于守势。

blocks.html_en: BOBBY ALLYN, BYLINE: As a soon-to-be seventh-grader, Joshua Pederson's son is like many kids his age.

sentences.en: BOBBY ALLYN, BYLINE: As a soon-to-be seventh-grader, Joshua Pederson's son is like many kids his age.
sentences.zh: 鲍比·艾林连线：约书亚·佩德森的儿子即将上七年级，他和许多同龄的孩子一样。

blocks.html_en: UNIDENTIFIED CHILD: The thing I'm looking forward to most in seventh grade is lunch, and the thing I (laughter) - and the thing I'm looking forward to least is everything else.

sentences.zh: 身份不明的孩子：我喜欢画可怕的东西和机器人，因为我认为可怕的东西和机器人很酷。

blocks.html_en: ALLYN: Two years ago, his family, who lives in Boston, had a nightmare scenario. They found a lump on their son's side that turned out to be cancer. After months of grueling chemotherapy and radiation, he was declared cancer free. But then the cancer returned. So Pederson entered his son into a clinical trial for a novel treatment. He asked that his son's name be withheld to discuss his medical condition. Not long after, Pederson read on the news that prediction market sites Kalshi and Polymarket are allowing people to bet on the outcome of clinical trials and whether the Food and Drug Administration will approve new medications.

content_html_zh:
作为即将上七年级的学生，约书亚·佩德森的儿子在谈论即将到来的学年时并没有充满热情。

“七年级时我最期待的是午餐，而我最不期待的是其他一切，”这位 12 岁的孩子说。

相关报道：NPR

艺术是他的爱好，但他不上课。 他喜欢自学。

“我喜欢画可怕的东西和机器人，”他说。 “因为我认为可怕的东西和机器人很酷。”

两年前，他住在波士顿的父母注意到他的肋骨周围有一个肿块，很快就变成了噩梦：这是癌症。

佩德森要求隐去儿子的姓名，以讨论他的健康状况细节。

经过几个月的艰苦化疗和放疗后，去年夏天他被宣布治愈了癌症。 然而几个月后，癌症复发了。 因此，佩德森让他的儿子参加了一项新疗法的临床试验。

就在那时，佩德森读到了这样的消息：预测市场网站 Kalshi 和 Polymarket 已经开始允许人们对临床试验的结果以及美国食品和药物管理局是否会批准新药物进行投注。

波士顿大学人文学科教授佩德森说：“首席执行官的声明中似乎忽略了这样一个事实：这些赌注的另一边将会有患者。”

投注者会根据临床试验的成功或失败来赚钱或赔钱，佩德森认为这种情况很可怕。

他说：“临床试验失败是一种更简洁的委婉说法，即人们将遭受痛苦，人们将死亡，在一生中最困难的医疗情况之一中，人们可获得的临床选择将减少。”

研究人员担心“破坏试验的完整性”

相关报道：NPR

在监管宽松的预测市场网站上，每周的交易额达数十亿美元，用户可以对从电影评论到选举再到中东冲突等各种事物进行投注。 临床试验只是该行业快速增长引发伦理问题的最新领域。

卡尔希声称，此类押注将提供新的信息来源，了解哪些药物将获得批准，以及哪些临床试验将显示出有希望的结果，该公司表示，这些信息可以帮助投资者决定资助哪些新药。

相关报道：NPR

Kalshi 发言人杰克·萨奇 (Jack Such) 表示：“如果你想禁止从临床试验失败中获利，你可以从股票市场开始，因为这种类型的利润的经济激励要大几个数量级。”他指的是从临床试验失败中获利的股市卖空者。

“虽然卡尔希和股票市场在这方面是相同的，但它们确实在一个重要方面有所不同：股票市场不会向研究人员提供任何有价值的信息，”萨奇说。

然而，药物试验研究人员还远没有被说服。

在旧金山湾区一家生物技术公司负责临床试验的大卫·蔡（David Tsai）发起了一份在线请愿书，要求禁止此类投注，他认为药物试验投注“威胁到了生物技术领域信任和诚信的基础”。

蔡担心，赌博的前景为那些参与临床试验的人提供了篡改预测市场支付结果的理由。

“如果我们正在对一种需要输注的肿瘤药物进行试验，药剂师打赌说它会很好地发挥作用，或者不会很好地发挥作用，显然可以调整输注速度，可以调整药物的源温度，”他说。 “他们可以改变任意数量的变量，这些变量显然可能对试验、数据和患者安全的结果产生直接影响。”

另一位怀疑论者是佛罗里达州杰克逊维尔梅奥诊所的放射肿瘤学教授尼古拉斯·扎尔斯基(Nicholas Zaorsky)，他帮助开展了临床试验，并同意预测市场可能会干扰救生药物的进步。

“预测市场在某些情况下可能很有价值，因为它们汇总信息，但临床试验有根本的不同：​​研究人员、协调员，有时甚至参与者都可以直接影响所押注结果的各个方面，”扎奥尔斯基说。 “这会产生经济激励，从而有可能破坏试验的完整性。”

患者父亲：押注于试验的人“与真实成本相去甚远”

Kalshi 聘请了自己的专家，包括基因检测公司 23andMe 的创始人 Anne Wojcicki，为市场提供担保，以此作为保持领先于医学突破并使临床试验更容易进行的一种方式。

“大多数患者不知道临床试验中可用的选择或哪些项目最有希望。 拥有一个关于试验概率的开放、透明的数据集的机会对人们来说是非常有希望和赋权的，”卡尔希赞助的一份白皮书指出。

在 Kalshi 上，用户目前可以押注减肥药物和乳腺癌治疗是否会获得联邦监管机构的批准以及批准日期。

Polymarket 拒绝发表评论，该公司正在对癌症治疗的批准以及美国是否允许中国肽出售给美国人进行押注。

卡尔希认为，通过公司核实就业的保障措施和监控异常市场活动的工具，可以最大限度地减少内幕交易的可能性。

相关报道：NPR

事实上，预测市场已经帮助识别了其他市场的内幕交易者，从特朗普总统的提词器操作员到前国会议员乔治·桑托斯，再到根据军事情报对委内瑞拉领导人尼古拉斯·马杜罗倒台进行投注的特种部队士兵。

相关报道：NPR

考虑到有多少人可以参与临床试验，蔡认为要先发制人地抓住每一个坏人可能并不那么容易。

佩德森也对此表示怀疑。 他认为，市场掩盖了处于临床试验中心的患者，他们对试验结果的利益最大。

他说：“这些平台让我印象深刻的一点是，它们很华丽，而且以一种游戏化的方式让你常常远离真正的成本。”

Kalshi 表示，它正在对已经选定参与者的后期临床试验进行押注。 它还表示，不允许在所有试验对象都是未成年人的市场上进行投注。 但这可能会改变。

佩德森说，如果确实如此，他想知道试验中的研究人员是否会受到预测市场利润的激励，这会加剧他的焦虑，也会加重他儿子已经承受的负担。

佩德森说：“他承受的压力、他被要求做的事情以及他被要求忍受的事情已经太多了。”

他希望 Kalshi 和 Polymarket 停止让投机者押注临床试验不会成功。

他认为，投注者不应该仅仅为了赚钱而支持一种失败的实验药物。

“这是一个黑暗的想法，”他说。 “这太可怕了。”

成绩单

张艾莎，主持人：

Kalshi 和 Polymarket 等预测市场网站已将世界变成了赌场。 这些公司允许对电影评论、总统言论、中东冲突、选举等进行投注。 但现在他们开始对危及患者生命的临床试验进行投注。 正如美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的鲍比·艾林 (Bobby Allyn) 报道的那样，由于研究人员和患者的抵制越来越强烈，该行业已处于守势。
